spotlight_events.title: Venice Carnival
spotlight_events.description: Masks, canals, and candlelit palaces turn Venice into a theatrical winter journey with history on every corner.
spotlight_events.story_headline: One of the world's great carnivals, where the whole city becomes a floating stage.

spotlight_events.title: Rio Carnival
spotlight_events.description: Samba schools, beach days, and late-night street parties create one of the most vivid reasons to cross the Atlantic.
spotlight_events.story_headline: If you want a trip built around pure momentum, Rio hands the city over to rhythm.

spotlight_events.title: Tomorrowland
spotlight_events.description: A small Belgian town turns into a temporary city for EDM, stages, camping, and global weekend crews.
spotlight_events.story_headline: One of the world's largest EDM festivals, made for turning a European summer into a party route.

spotlight_events.title: Northern lights
spotlight_events.description: Long winter nights, geothermal pools, and aurora windows make Iceland a compact trip built around timing and sky.
spotlight_events.story_headline: It is not only about the sky: hot springs, roads, and black beaches become a winter ritual.

spotlight_events.title: Dajia Mazu pilgrimage
spotlight_events.description: A multi-day walking pilgrimage connects temple towns, street food, and local belief across central Taiwan.
spotlight_events.story_headline: A moving festival of faith and local culture, made for a slower Taiwan route.

spotlight_events.title: Gion Matsuri
spotlight_events.description: A month of historic floats, night markets, and summer rituals turns Kyoto into one of Japan's most atmospheric journeys.
spotlight_events.story_headline: Kyoto's summer festival turns old streets, floats, and night markets into a living route.

spotlight_events.title: Fuji Rock
spotlight_events.description: Forests, camping, and multi-stage music turn Japan's summer into an outdoor trip that rewards early planning.
spotlight_events.story_headline: Not only a lineup. It is a temporary music city in the mountains.

spotlight_events.title: Kyoto sakura
spotlight_events.description: From the Kamo River and Philosopher's Path to temple night blossoms, Kyoto sakura rewards slow walking days.
spotlight_events.story_headline: It is not just a photo season. The whole city softens for a short two-week window.

spotlight_events.title: Korankei autumn leaves
spotlight_events.description: A river valley, bridges, and evening lights make autumn color feel like a walkable route.
spotlight_events.story_headline: When Kyoto feels crowded, Korankei is a quieter autumn radar point with real texture.

spotlight_events.title: Boryeong Mud Festival
spotlight_events.description: Beach games, mud events, and summer concerts turn Korea's west coast into a friend-group trip.
spotlight_events.story_headline: A very direct reason to turn a beach weekend into a festival trip.

spotlight_events.title: Jinhae cherry blossom
spotlight_events.description: Railways, streams, and citywide blossoms make Jinhae one of Korea's most visual spring trips.
spotlight_events.story_headline: A classic Korean spring radar point that pairs naturally with Busan.

spotlight_events.title: Hong Kong Sevens
spotlight_events.description: Rugby, parties, and nightlife make this one of Hong Kong's highest-energy weekends.
spotlight_events.story_headline: One sporting weekend turns the city into a social and nightlife route.

spotlight_events.title: Hong Kong Flower Show
spotlight_events.description: A large city flower show that pairs well with Hong Kong Island walks, cafes, and harbor nights.
spotlight_events.story_headline: For a light spring city trip, Hong Kong's flower show is an easy starting point.

spotlight_events.title: Rainforest World Music Festival
spotlight_events.description: Rainforest settings, global music, and Borneo culture make this a festival far from normal city routes.
spotlight_events.story_headline: Less mega-stage, more music village inside the rainforest.

spotlight_events.title: Singapore Grand Prix
spotlight_events.description: Night racing, waterfront concerts, and late city dining make Singapore a compact trip built around high-energy evenings.
spotlight_events.story_headline: Night racing, concerts, and late food compress a short city trip into one dense weekend.

spotlight_events.title: Singapore and Malaysia durian season
spotlight_events.description: Ripe durian stalls and late-night food routes turn Singapore and Malaysia into a flavor-first trip.
spotlight_events.story_headline: When the travel reason is eating, durian season can become the whole route.

spotlight_events.title: Taipei food season
spotlight_events.description: Night markets, snacks, bistros, and cafes make Taipei easy to plan around multiple meals a day.
spotlight_events.story_headline: Taipei does not need a huge festival to become a food-first trip.

spotlight_events.title: Taiwan Lantern Festival
spotlight_events.description: Large-scale lantern installations and local night markets create an easy route for travelers who want light, food, and culture.
spotlight_events.story_headline: Main lanterns, local food, and evening walks make this an easy light-based journey.
